description: This source file defines an AuthService class responsible for user authentication management, including login, registration, session restoration, and logout, utilizing shared preferences for local storage.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: A service class managing user authentication state, including login, registration, session persistence, and logout.

methods.name: AuthService
methods.description: Constructor that initializes AuthService with a SharedPreferences instance.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Simulates a user login by validating input, generating a mock token, storing user info in preferences, and returning a User object.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Simulates user registration, then calls login to store user details.

methods.name: restoreSession
methods.description: Attempts to restore a user session from stored preferences and returns a User object if successful.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears all stored session data from shared preferences.
